payload.title: Android: Compose object-collection state (FrickQuery equivalent via collectAsState)
payload.description: Kotlin/Compose parity with FR-138 (@FrickQuery SwiftUI property wrapper). A Compose-friendly helper (e.g. a rememberFrickQuery/composable or Flow) that subscribes to an object collection and surfaces it as Compose state, mirroring the SwiftUI @FrickQuery ergonomics.
